content: We need number of CH3 groups in the compound. But we don't have the compound given. Possibly the sample is the one we have NMR data for? No data yet. We need to get NMR spectra to infer methyl groups. Could also retrieve carbon shifts etc. But we need the structure. Maybe the compound is known from context? No context provided. We need to request proton NMR spectra to see methyl signals. Use proton_nmr_spectra tool. That will give spectrum string. Then we can count methyl peaks (triplet around 0.9 ppm etc). But we need to interpret. Could also use carbon NMR to see methyl carbons (~10-30 ppm). Might be easier: count number of methyl signals in carbon NMR. Use carbon_nmr_spectra. Let's call carbon_nmr_spectra.
